name: How long does a typical door frame modification project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door frame modification project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door frame modification project varies based on its complexity. A simple enlargement or height adjustment for a standard interior door might take one to two days. More extensive modifications, such as structural changes or incorporating new headers for wider exterior openings, could extend to several days, especially if permit acquisition or additional structural work is involved. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing the specific requirements of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on complexity, ranging from one to two days for simple adjustments to several days for extensive structural modifications.
